description: A selector-drift test case whose answer is known: real DOM captures of a breakable app before and after one UI change (renamed label, swapped buttons, duplicated locator, element moved behind a menu…), plus the verdict the two contracts MUST produce. No arguments lists the scenarios; an id returns "baseline" and "current". THE LOOP: diff_mappings on baseline and current must return this tool's "expected" verdict and counts exactly; a mismatch means this server's diff engine drifted, not your input. Deterministic, offline, committed fixtures. Live: https://www.ia-qa.com/devtools/sandbox

include_html.description: Include the generated HTML of the mutated page (default false). Only useful if you want to render or re-capture it yourself; the loop does not need it.

scenario.description: Scenario id; omit to list every scenario with its expected verdict. Ids: no-change, swap-label, add-testid, duplicate-role-name, remove-element, insert-sibling, rename-label, counter-label, move-behind-menu, add-element

name: sandbox_scenario
